result.markdown:
For most small businesses, I would recommend **Gusto, BambooHR, or Rippling**\. The best choice depends on whether you need payroll, employee management, or a complete HR system.

Here are my top picks for 2026.

## Best HR software for small businesses

![Gusto Logo PNG,  Vector (AI, EPS, CDR, PDF, SVG) - iconLogoVector](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/ftD0qJ1yBSoWTtDEs2sOfDQ7-65e7zEzHy-HIAb3bqFrmNGGc0DyUX0E7CdY1ulVg_3Q5_8qLVi4LE1wqaQS_JVEpU9pxbwM6Kz6OYgPCcQM2vYw21WPy-MCNW4IYnmmdNSrLtuLoIyJLYtPy5hO5B7jEV7698TKyyKP6yzFWMR7Sgf2P81H8Y7V-Tx23IPn?purpose=fullsize)

**1\. Gusto**

(Best overall for small businesses)

Best for payroll, onboarding, employee records, benefits, and tax filing.

- Starting price: \$49/month + \$6/employee
- Easy to use
- Excellent for companies with 2–50 employees

Website: [Gusto](https://gusto.com/)

---

![How to Use BambooHR - Getting Started Guide (2026) | Delv](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/1eEILrPS5kwPkgNwYw7R5-fSnQEm5WOJ3mO9wAe9tHrox_ii2fkN7RtteSGmwi-6qitJLoQZs1FRAP2kjVoJ49Jp-AjTjDQtr9b5VlRxrraDCzcOaPuqAcc3XeVxoctViebYCP_ecjlJwjlD7MBkZOx5riXcchKDVW9q8jz3YTQ7r9I5oNzcVbSfteMz5-Pg?purpose=fullsize)

**2\. BambooHR**

(Best dedicated HR system)

Best for managing employees and organizing HR operations.

- Employee records and personnel files
- PTO and vacation tracking
- Hiring and onboarding
- Performance reviews
- HR reporting

Pricing: Typically starts around \$250/month for companies with 25 or fewer employees.

Website: [BambooHR](https://www.bamboohr.com/)

---

![Rippling Company Profile Funding & Investors | YourStory](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/SAzMvIL6PtbUMLb8gBTabCeVnrSEXbTwCT-aC0SC4jJFQ74dXv0idEYA-gW8Xf4QyVq2JUnFjv2iQman7uk3D8kUDVp4a4whGwY7X8hxbhcNKKU6eqdr0HQC44Yinb10-d1Qx8pYpUGPKlk3izjNGAFETr0jiBpGuRO01GQ7GCiUG98Lat9yOYtjvREa50cA?purpose=fullsize)

**3\. Rippling**

(Best all-in-one automation)

Best for businesses that want HR, payroll, IT, and employee management connected.

- Automated onboarding
- Payroll and benefits
- Employee management
- Time and attendance
- Software and device management

Pricing: Starts around \$8/employee/month plus a base fee, depending on modules.

Website: [Rippling](https://www.rippling.com/)

---

![Introducing Zoho People 5.0 | Streamlined & secure HR software](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/N2tyoCYDXo_2X8HD_5-SWCfDBpBrfnJxvS27zq0luRDcSBxvb5ksF8GIcSrns-PjyFB81AcM6r9iE-CSXiUONYeUFYVq66I46rVVwsJXPLlWkRDDpj17x51dneUMDGMOeIbB1fDSAq7EtcK5moqwY1sb0xYonWwdnsoigFpIV0zzd1uQR8FzhmzsLBPdP8qA?purpose=fullsize)

**4\. Zoho People**

(Best budget option)

Best for smaller companies that want affordable HR management.

- Employee database
- Leave management
- Attendance tracking
- Performance management
- Custom HR workflows

Pricing: Entry-level plans start around \$1.50 per employee/month.

Website: [Zoho People](https://www.zoho.com/people/)

---

![RUN Powered by ADP® Payroll Software | ADP](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/RpGcHs-PaNOo1cKIxFpsEQuw9zfE12TEYccICxkqqcA3CO2NvRfDtJbCfHi2Nr0YYYblVCChq2UL52-TzeRVq7RXCW745y0Vk8MEKZHTp113Xnj3kep_aCHaeYLzdBWH7veM5Y6_lQASKp9n8UaI6GWb3lo9RY4lH6rVom7VA1O8HweTnOpsYnwKG4YX01TL?purpose=fullsize)

**5\. ADP RUN**
Best for payroll, tax compliance, and HR support.

- Payroll processing
- Tax filing
- Employee onboarding
- HR resources
- Compliance assistance

Pricing: Custom quotes.

Website: [ADP RUN](https://www.adp.com/what-we-offer/products/run-powered-by-adp.aspx)

Pricing is approximate and depends on employee count, selected features, and add-ons.
